note: Controls present in the before capture and absent from the after capture, with what happened to each. check-inventory.mjs reads this file: a control accounted for here is not a loss, and anything not listed is. The list is the only way a capability may legitimately leave the product, so it is short and every entry names the commit that did it.

removed.name: 9Remote
removed.why: A rail button and promo modal advertising a separate product. Removed with NineRemoteButton, NineRemotePromoModal and their nav entries; nothing in this product depended on it.

removed.name: 9English
removed.why: An outbound link to a separate product, rendered twice per page as a rail button and a header link. Removed with the same change.

removed.name: Donate
removed.why: The donation ask: a header button and DonateModal, plus the donateUrl endpoint constant only that modal read.

relabelled.now: Select all rows on this page

relabelledPrefix.why: One checkbox per model row, labelled with the row's own model id, so the pair is a prefix rather than a fixed string.

volatile.why: Recharts builds the chart's accessible name from its axis tick text, so the key embeds the timestamps of whatever window was loaded. It changes between two captures of an unchanged page and is not a capability.
